objects.name: board
objects.description: One classroom's discussion board — the school's own noun for the room a civic chapter calls a chat thread.

objects.name: board_post
objects.description: One post a teacher or pupil leaves on a classroom board.

objects.name: board_bookmark
objects.description: Where a teacher or pupil stopped reading a classroom board, so the board shows what was posted since.

objects.name: board_shelf
objects.description: A classroom board one teacher or pupil has put away for themselves, so it leaves their list of boards and nobody else's.

objects.name: homework_query
objects.description: One conversation about a piece of homework: privately between a pupil and the teaching staff, or among the whole class it was set for.

objects.name: homework_reply
objects.description: One message on a homework conversation, signed by the teaching staff when a teacher answers.

objects.name: conversation
objects.description: One private correspondence between a parent and a member of staff, or among a group of them.

objects.name: correspondent
objects.description: One person's standing on one conversation.

objects.name: letter
objects.description: One end-to-end encrypted letter on a conversation.

objects.name: sticker
objects.description: One reader's sticker on one letter.

objects.name: handset_key
objects.description: One published public key for one of a parent's or teacher's handsets.

objects.name: concern
objects.description: One parent or pupil asking the pastoral team to look at a board post.

objects.name: takedown
objects.description: The pastoral team withholding a board post from a classroom.

objects.name: clearance
objects.description: The pastoral team leaving a reported board post standing.

objects.name: appeal
objects.description: An author contesting the takedown of their own post, decided by a year head above the classroom that took it down.

objects.name: contact_code
objects.description: One of a parent's contact codes — the handle the school can write to without publishing which parent it belongs to.

objects.name: blocked_contact
objects.description: One parent refusing everything from one contact code.

objects.name: announcement
objects.description: One thing that happened in the school and that one parent, pupil or teacher should be told about.

indexes.name: term_digest
indexes.description: Finds every unread announcement for one recipient, which is how the school builds a weekly digest.

objects.name: announcement_setting
objects.description: One recipient's decision to mute one category of announcement.

objects.name: browser_alert
objects.description: One browser a parent or teacher asked to be alerted on when an announcement reaches them.
